edition: Porphyry, On the Cave of the Nymphs, trans. Thomas Taylor (London: John M. Watkins, 1917)
order: The rules apply in the order this list gives them, first to last, each one to every occurrence, one text block at a time — the order the reading view applies them in and the order their hits are counted in. Order decides: a rule whose find an earlier rule has already replaced fires zero times, and the build FAILS on a rule that fires zero times, so a redundant rule is caught rather than shipped. The classes are grouped in the order the pipeline needs them: opener (the divisions, which the extraction itself needs before it can find a section), digit (the printed numbers and the note markers, pinned to the line or the marker they were read from), ocr (a word whose letters the transcription lost).

classes.opener: a division number the transcription mangled, where the print has a reading
classes.digit: a printed number or a note marker read through an OCR digit confusion
classes.ocr: a word carrying a character that is not a letter; the character is removed, no reading is offered
classes.review: a passage whose harm is real but whose correct reading cannot be determined from the source
